issue_context.title: tests-ci : portability: posix: common.dynamic_stack test Failed
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
common.dynamic_stack test is Failed on zephyr-v3.4.0-3926-g4ba97c22555e on mimxrt1060_evk
testcase path is portability/posix/common/dynamic_stack/nanosleep_execution

see logs for details

**To Reproduce**
1. 
```
scripts/twister --device-testing --device-serial /dev/ttyACM0 -p mimxrt1060_evk  --sub-test portability.posix
```
or
```
# cd tests/portability/posix/common/dynamic_stack/nanosleep_execution
# west build -b mimxrt1060_evk
# west flash
```
2. See error

**Expected behavior**
test pass

**Impact**


**Logs and console output**

```
START - test_nanosleep_execution

Assertion failed at WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/tests/posix/common/src/nanosleep.c:153: common_lower_bound_check: (actual_ns >= exp_ns is false)
actual: 96774 expected: 500000000
FAIL - test_nanosleep_execution in 0.016 seconds

    
```

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: (e.g. Linux )
 - Toolchain (e.g Zephyr SDK)
 - Commit SHA or Version used: zephyr-v3.4.0-3926-g4ba97c22555e
comments: Also fails on mimxrt1160_evk_cm7 for zephyr-v3.4.0-3926-g4ba97c22555e
Also fails on mimxrt595_evk_cm33 for zephyr-v3.4.0-3926-g4ba97c22555e
Also fails on mimxrt685_evk_cm33 for zephyr-v3.4.0-3926-g4ba97c22555e
hake, do we have a bisect on when this started failing?
@hakehuang , can you please try on the latest master. The test passed for me on RT685 EVK board.

The behavior is strange, it hangs at test
`START - test_nanosleep_errors_errno` when I run it from a reset, however the test passes on board powerup.
It hangs at a call to `k_sleep` because the value passed in to sleep is very high. Not sure what is causing this.

> hake, do we have a bisect on when this started failing?

per my analysis, the posix test cases is newly updated and cause this problem. some of them may be resolved by align the timer.
@hakehuang , can you provide more details on what additions are needed to the timer?

> @hakehuang , can you provide more details on what additions are needed to the timer?
ewfwe to this, basically, we need add a sleep before testing.
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/63210

> @hakehuang , can you provide more details on what additions are needed to the timer?
please refer to below pr.  Basically, we need add a sleep before testing.
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/63210

review_comments: Please add an assertion here to fail in the default case. Also mentioned in the previous review.

I see, annd add a unreachable assert in default 
'''
zassert_unreachable();
'''
